coverage_notes: Exhaustive sweep across 8 ETL/ELT products in scope (Fivetran, Airbyte, Talend, Matillion, Coalesce, dltHub, Bruin, Rubie) with coverage across official product pages, documentation, pricing, Crunchbase funding records, major review aggregators (G2, Capterra, TrustRadius, Gartner Peer Insights), analyst reports (Gartner Magic Quadrant, Forrester Wave), and high-quality practitioner comparisons. Additional sweep for competitive analysis (Fivetran vs. Airbyte comparisons), market research reports (Integrate.io, Weld, Estuary, Hevodata), GitHub repositories for open-source projects (dltHub, Bruin), and agentic/AI-powered ETL trends. Total sources dedup'd from 100+ search results to 68 verified, real sources. Tier distribution: T0 (20 primary sources: official homepages, pricing, Crunchbase records), T1 (14 official docs/API/releases), T2 (18 review aggregators and analyst reports), T3 (16 comparisons, analyses, blogs). Notable authorities: G2, Capterra, TrustRadius, Gartner, Forrester, Crunchbase, GitHub. Gaps deferred: detailed API specifications beyond landing pages; SEC filings (private companies); Talend/Qlik internal documentation post-acquisition; real-time pricing data requiring login; YouTube demo analysis.
